The Plan shall also include details of contingency parking arrangements that shall be put in place in the event of any mechanical failure to either the turntable or one or more car lifts. The hydraulic lift system shall be permanently maintained in fully working order and any repairs shall be completed within 72 hours should mechanical failure occur.
